title: SYNTHETIC: a manuscript number that is registered but has no derivation must abstain as EPHEMERAL_CLAIM, never pass and never be called false
scientific_question: Illustrative only (the setting is fictional): how many sightings did an invented survey of invented 'mooncress sprites' record across every plot of the fictional Glassreed Fen? No real survey, place or organism is described.
claim_tested: When a claim registry lists a claim (CLM-02, value 91) that has no derivation (no analysis recipe, code version, environment or input manifest) and no stored output, while its value is printed in the declared manuscript, the claim_registry check of scientific-evidence-gate reports ABSTAIN with reason UNVERIFIED and failure mode EPHEMERAL_CLAIM, names CLM-02 and every missing link, and the run as a whole exits 2 (ABSTAIN). It neither passes the claim nor marks it false, even though a fully traced sibling claim (CLM-01) resolves and every other check passes.
falsified_by: Running `science-gate verify manifest.json` from this entry directory yields any status other than ABSTAIN, any exit code other than 2, a primary reason other than UNVERIFIED, failure modes other than exactly [EPHEMERAL_CLAIM], a report.md that does not name CLM-02 or its missing derivation links, or a claim_registry verdict of PASS or FAIL.
